note: The LAST open boundary question in this market. Nine of the ten municipalities in the original packet were settled; Canton was held under FOUNDER_JUDGEMENT and is held still -- this order does not admit it and does not exclude it.
question: Canton Township adjoins Plymouth and Livonia, both registered on the livonia-plymouth-northville corridor, and lies between this market's two declared travel cores. It is also a large township on the western edge, and admitting it moves the boundary toward Ann Arbor. That is a judgement about how wide this market should be, which is why it was reserved rather than decided with the other nine.

committed_bounds_unchanged._disclosure: A loose enclosing box spanning the Detroit metro core, Oakland County suburbs, DTW airport, and the Ann Arbor / Washtenaw core, not an authoritative MSA boundary. Two distinct travel cores (Detroit and Ann Arbor) share this one box.

impact_if_ADMITTED.unresolved_change: +5 until each is routed and its policy read
impact_if_ADMITTED.note: Admitting does not publish anything: each candidate still has to clear identity, routing and a policy read on its own.

impact_if_EXCLUDED.unresolved_change: -5 -- they leave the review queue entirely
impact_if_EXCLUDED.note: An explicit out-of-market ruling naming Canton stops these candidates re-surfacing as UNRESOLVED on every future recensus. Silence does not: that is what produced this packet.

impact_if_HELD_AGAIN.note: They stay MARKET_MEMBERSHIP_UNRESOLVED and return unchanged at the next recensus. Holding is a legitimate answer; it is just not a durable one.

recommended_ruling.reasoning: Every candidate sits inside the market's own committed bounds, Canton adjoins two registered cities on the same corridor, and the eight municipalities admitted in the previous order were admitted on exactly this reasoning. Excluding Canton alone would leave the western edge drawn by which city strings happened to be typed into a corridor list -- which is the condition this whole boundary review existed to end. The counter-argument is real and is why this was reserved: Canton is large and pulls the boundary toward Ann Arbor.
recommended_ruling.note: A RECOMMENDATION. No ruling is applied by this order.
